using namespace std;

int min_val;

void check(const vector<pair<int,int>>& aa, int a[3], int b[3]) {
    int a_copy[3], b_copy[3];
    memcpy(a_copy, a, sizeof(a_copy));
    memcpy(b_copy, b, sizeof(b_copy));
    for (size_t i = 0; i < aa.size(); ++i) {
        int m = min(a_copy[aa[i].first], b_copy[aa[i].second]);
        a_copy[aa[i].first] -= m;
        b_copy[aa[i].second] -= m;
    }
    int curr = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) curr += a_copy[i];
    min_val = min(min_val, curr);
}

void per(vector<pair<int,int>>& aa, int index, int a[3], int b[3]) {
    check(aa, a, b);
    for (size_t i = index; i < aa.size(); ++i) {
        swap(aa[i], aa[index]);
        per(aa, index + 1, a, b);
        swap(aa[i], aa[index]);
    }
}

    cin >> n;
